verdict.rationale: Deel's marketing pages assert it can 'run accurate, compliant payroll' across worker types and countries, and API/MCP docs expose contracts, time-off, and payroll data objects, but there is no concrete documentation of an end-to-end run flow showing hours review, totals preview, and a single submit action. missing for 10: dedicated payroll-run UI/API walkthrough showing hours review, totals preview, and submission step in one flow, and independent confirmation the flow works as described.
